<function name="PlayerButtonUp" parent="GM" type="hook">
	<description>Called when a player releases a button.

This will not be called if player has a panel opened with keyboard input enabled, use <page>PANEL:OnKeyCodeReleased</page> instead.

See <page>GM:KeyRelease</page> for an alternative that uses <page>Enums/IN</page>.
See <page>GM:PlayerButtonDown</page> for the "key press" event.
</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<predicted>Yes</predicted>
	<args>
		<arg name="ply" type="Player">Player who released the button</arg>
		<arg name="button" type="number{BUTTON_CODE}">The button, see <page>Enums/BUTTON_CODE</page></arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Prints the person who released the key.</description>
	<code>
hook.Add( "PlayerButtonUp", "ButtonUpWikiExample", function( ply, button )
	if CLIENT then
		if ( IsFirstTimePredicted() ) then print( ply:Nick() .. " released " .. input.GetKeyName( button ) ) end
	else
		print( ply:Nick() .. " released " .. button )
	end
end)

	</code>
</example>
